heading: Section 80C Deductions: Full List & The ₹1.5 Lakh Limit Explained (FY 2025-26)
tldr: Section 80C allows individuals and Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs) to reduce their taxable income by investing in or spending on specific instruments.
The maximum deduction available under Section 80C is ₹1.5 lakh in a financial year, which is a combined limit for all eligible investments and expenses.
Popular options include Public Provident Fund (PPF), Equity Linked Savings Schemes (ELSS), life insurance premiums, and Employees' Provident Fund (EPF) contributions.
Other eligible deductions cover home loan principal repayments, children's tuition fees, and stamp duty/registration charges for a new house.
Utilising Section 80C effectively is a fundamental part of tax planning, helping to lower your overall tax liability.
caption:
Want to save money on your taxes? Section 80C is your best friend! It lets you cut down the amount of income you pay tax on, up to ₹1.5 lakh, just by investing in simple things like PPF or paying for life insurance. Think of it as a smart way to keep more of your hard-earned money. Learn all about how to use it effectively in our latest article.
